# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v2 c5 P3](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0003), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** School pupil  <sub>[v2 c5 P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony is a cute little boy with a dark, sullen face. He has hostile black eyes.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)_

## Personality

Anthony is an independent, somewhat mischievous boy who insists on making up his own mind about things. He initially holds female teachers in contempt and exhibits a sullen, scornful manner of obedience. However, he shows respect when firm discipline is applied.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_

## Traits

- Independent  <sub>[v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007)</sub>
- Mischievous  <sub>[v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)</sub>
- Sullen  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)</sub>

## History

Anthony Pye attends Avonlea School, where he sits by himself at a corner desk in the classroom. When Anne Shirley becomes his teacher, he stares at her with hostile black eyes, having previously only had male teachers and believing that female teachers are no good. During one of his early days under Anne's instruction, he pours the last drops of water from his slate bottle down Aurelia Clay's neck, after which Anne keeps him in at recess to give him a lecture on how gentlemen ought to behave. Though Anne attempts to win his affection through patience and kindness, Anthony continues to obey her with a scornful air of toleration. However, after Anne eventually administers a whipping to him, Anthony decides she is worth something after all, remarking that the whipping was as good as a man's.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_
